verdict.rationale: AvaTax documents first-party support for product-taxability differences across jurisdictions. It also offers AI tax-code recommendations and an AI-assisted explanation of how and why tax was calculated, which partially covers the visible-research element. However, nothing in the evidence specifically addresses SaaS taxability by state, digital-goods rules, or bundled offerings. missing for 10: explicit SaaS state-by-state taxability documentation, digital-goods rule coverage, bundled-offering handling, visible per-determination research or citations, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder selling software, the product gets the hard cases right — SaaS taxability that differs by state, digital-goods rules, and bundled offerings — with the research behind each determination visible

citations.quote: Support scenarios such as product taxability differences, exemption logic, shipping rules, and temporary tax changes without building custom rule engines.
Explain how and why tax was calculated, with AI-assisted analysis of jurisdiction breakdowns, sourcing decisions, exemption status, and compliance rules.
Provides AI-powered tax code recommendations for products. Returns 1 to 3 ranked tax code suggestions with confidence levels
